work_unit: Real fictional-sample evaluation adapter and hosted Langfuse experiment

coordinator_owned_work: shared metric functions and regression tests
integration review, live execution and read-back verification

outcome.status: accepted evaluation implementation; application-quality failures measured
checks: 40 focused tests passed across adapter, scorer, runner and dataset uploader
Ruff check and format check passed for eight script/test files
Dry run validated all ten reviewed cases without network access
Preflight preserved OpenAI models/key and guardrails while isolating storage and disabling application tracing
Live OpenAI run completed all ten cases with zero provider/runtime errors
Langfuse CLI read-back matched ten outputs, 26 item scores and six aggregate scores
environment_findings: Run pytest as python -m pytest so the backend scripts namespace resolves
Mypy requires explicit package bases for these namespace script imports
Following all imports exposes an existing unrelated app/observability.py:257 protocol mismatch; production code was not changed
Network execution used approved sandbox escalation; no credentials were printed
Langfuse experiment output is JSON text and must be decoded before local comparison
integration_review: Async SDK task offloads synchronous application services to a thread to avoid nested event loops
Expected answers are only available to the evaluator, never the application task
Two hash-pinned fictional images use temporary storage, cached preparation and cleanup
Remote dataset edits and missing SDK scores are rejected
Multi-line source coverage and normalized date comparison are versioned as evaluator v0.2
limitations: Five answerable cases failed expected content/citation checks and remain visible in the baseline
The experiment is a service benchmark, not a browser, auth, database or MinIO test
Metrics are deterministic reference checks on two samples, not an LLM judge or production accuracy claim
Provider token usage and cost are unavailable in the current contracts
No production service edits, commit, push or deployment were performed
